revision.seed_method: Native initial WRITE plus idempotent same-value/same-confirmed CORRECT; active slots cannot accept repeated WRITE
revision.scope: One real heldout observation; formal selected-slot revision intervention, not new physical events or robot task SR

decoding: NativePi05Actor unrestricted greedy, max96, real EOS; no repair/grammar constraints
